summary: Frontend-only Groups crash regression check completed. App stayed stable when opening Groups routes in mobile web preview, and no runtime crash/overlay error was reproduced under current unauthenticated auth gate.

integration_issues.flow: Groups -> Conferences sub-tab runtime behavior after authentication
integration_issues.issue: Could not fully validate in this run because preview remained auth-gated (no completed interactive OIDC session). Route-level stability was verified only up to sign-in gate.

react_native_issues.issue: Non-blocking warnings persist (expo-notifications web limitation, deprecated shadow*/textShadow* props, expo-av deprecation).

action_items: Run one authenticated regression on native/web: sign in -> tap Groups tab -> switch to Conferences sub-tab, and confirm no crash with real Convex session.
If conferences items use a non-_id identifier, harden keyExtractor and row onPress mapping to avoid undefined keys/navigation edge cases.
critical_code_review_comments: groups.tsx now uses useSafeConvexQuery for both group and optional conferences data, with conferences query enabled only when that sub-tab is active; this removes immediate optional-endpoint crash risk on initial tab open.

Potential remaining risk: FlatList keyExtractor and row navigation assume item._id for both datasets; if conferences payload differs, list key stability/navigation may degrade (likely warning-level, not reproduced as crash here).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Read /app/memory/test_credentials.md before testing. This run verified route stability for /groups and /(tabs)/groups under auth gating only; authenticated in-tab interactions still require live OIDC session.
rca_of_issue: Original crash likely came from direct Convex useQuery calls on optional/missing endpoints in Groups screen. Current implementation wraps those calls in useSafeConvexQuery and defers conferences query activation until its tab is selected, which prevents immediate route crash in the tested unauthenticated path.
